title: Origin story: Huitzilopochtli
description: Huitzilopochtli was the patron god of the Mexica, born fully armed from his mother Coatlicue, slaying his sister the moon and his star-brothers at birth. He guided the Mexica to Tenochtitlan and demanded the sun's nourishment through war — the sun that must be fed to rise each day.

title: Ability profile: Huitzilopochtli
description: Ranked abilities: War — rank 100/100; Ferocity — rank 99/100; Solar power — rank 98/100; Endurance — rank 97/100; Leadership — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Huitzilopochtli
description: Powers: The sun's daily battle as his duty; The hummingbird's impossible flight; The Mexica people as his living temple.

title: Stamina feats: Huitzilopochtli
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fights the darkness every single day; Led a people across deserts to their city.

title: Crossover notes: Huitzilopochtli
description: Huitzilopochtli crosses naturally with: the sun, war, the Mexica people.

title: Cultural impact: Huitzilopochtli
description: Tenochtitlan's great temple; the sun as warrior.
